title: Worker handoff names .worktrees/ even when the delegation used an explicit worktreePath
outcome: The worker handoff's retention line points at the worktree path the delegation actually used, so a worker spawned with an explicit Git-ignored worktreePath outside `.worktrees/` is told the right place to clean up.
acceptance: Worker handoff names .worktrees/ even when the delegation used an explicit worktreePath is done
